title: A Psalm for the Wild-Built (cover)
lede: The cover of Becky Chambers’s first Monk and Robot novella, a widely read work of solarpunk fiction about a tea monk and a robot.
summary: Cover art by Feifei Ruan, design by Christine Foltzer, for Becky Chambers’s solarpunk novella. Tordotcom, 2021.

source.label: Reactor (Tor.com): Revealing A Psalm for the Wild-Built by Becky Chambers

made: Cover revealed 22 September 2020; book published 13 July 2021 (Reactor)

evidence.note: Based on the publisher’s cover-reveal post, the Wikipedia article on the solarpunk genre, and the Wikidata edition item. The cover image was not inspected, so no visual traits are recorded.

styles.note: The cover of one of the best-known solarpunk novels. The fit rests on the book’s documented genre; its cover has not been inspected.

context: Reactor (then Tor.com) revealed the cover on 22 September 2020 and credits “Art by Feifei Ruan; Design by Christine Foltzer”. The book was published on 13 July 2021. In the story, a tea monk meets a robot that wants to know “what do people need?”. [Reactor](https://reactormag.com/cover-reveal-a-psalm-for-the-wild-built-by-becky-chambers/).

Wikipedia’s solarpunk article says that in 2018 Becky Chambers agreed to write two solarpunk novellas for Tor Books, and that she published *A Psalm for the Wild-Built* (2021) and *A Prayer for the Crown-Shy* (2022). [Wikipedia: Solarpunk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solarpunk).
Wikidata has an item for the Tor hardcover edition with a cover-artist statement. [Wikidata Q107583570](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q107583570).
Feifei Ruan sells signed prints of the cover art. [Feifei Ruan shop](https://www.feifeiruan.shop/product-page/print-a-psalm-for-the-wild-built).
interpretation: The novellas are among the most widely read solarpunk fiction, so their covers are among the images most people meet first for the genre. A curator should inspect the cover before it is used as visual evidence.
